ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the figure "Changes Along the Course in the Multi-year Average Sediment Transport Volume and Runoff Volume of the Tarim River." <image1> What is the main factor affecting the change in sediment transport volume in the lower reaches of the Tarim River?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows the changes along the course in the multi-year average sediment transport volume and multi-year average runoff volume of the mainstream of the Tarim River. The horizontal axis is distance, and the river sections go from the upper reaches and middle reaches to the lower reaches. The lower reaches are located on the right side of the figure. In the lower-reach section, the multi-year average sediment transport volume curve continues to decrease to the right, approaching 0 near the end; the multi-year average runoff volume curve also decreases along the course, and is basically consistent with the change trend of sediment transport volume. Then reason: A river's sediment-carrying capacity is controlled by the amount of water; the smaller the flow volume, the weaker the ability to carry sediment. In the figure, the decrease in sediment transport volume in the lower reaches is synchronous with the decrease in runoff volume, so the main factor affecting the change in sediment transport volume in the lower reaches of the Tarim River is flow volume.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the figure "Changes Along the Course in the Multi-year Average Sediment Transport Volume and Runoff Volume of the Tarim River."

<image1>

What is the main factor affecting the change in sediment transport volume in the lower reaches of the Tarim River?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：定位图中下游河段，读取多年平均输沙量曲线和多年平均径流量曲线的沿程变化，发现下游输沙量持续减小，同时径流量也持续减小且二者变化趋势一致。再结合题干要求“影响下游输沙量变化的主要因素”，用河流输沙能力受流量控制的地理规律，把同步变化的径流量判定为主因。答案写“流量”或“径流量”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图示为塔里木河干流沿程多年平均输沙量和多年平均径流量变化，横轴为距离，河段从上游、中游到下游。下游位于图中右侧，在下游河段，多年平均输沙量曲线继续向右降低，接近末端时接近于0；多年平均径流量曲线也沿程减小，和输沙量的变化趋势基本一致。再推理：河流输沙能力受水量大小控制，流量越小，携带泥沙能力越弱。图中下游输沙量减小与径流量减小同步，因此影响塔里木河下游输沙量变化的主要因素是流量。
method.answer_match_reason: 预测答案“流量（径流量）”与标准答案“流量”含义一致，均指出影响塔里木河下游输沙量变化的主要因素是流量/径流量。

answer_match_part_results.reason: “径流量”在此语境下与河流流量对应，表达的是同一主要影响因素。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: 这是最直接且充分的图像判读路线：通过比较下游段两条曲线的同步变化来确定主控因素。题目本身只要求识别主要因素，其他独立路线较少。
planner_metadata.image_role: 从图中读取塔里木河干流沿程分为上游、中游、下游；横轴为距高程/距离，左纵轴为多年平均输沙量，右纵轴为多年平均径流量。观察下游段，两条曲线均随距离增加而明显降低并趋近于低值，输沙量的下降趋势与径流量下降趋势一致。
planner_metadata.text_role: 题干要求读“塔里木河多年平均输沙量和径流量沿程变化”图，并询问影响塔里木河下游输沙量变化的主要因素；需聚焦下游段和输沙量变化原因。
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 河流输沙能力主要受水量/流量控制：流量越大，搬运泥沙能力越强；流量减少时，输沙量通常随之减少。因此在下游若输沙量与径流量同步降低，可判断径流量即流量是主要影响因素。
